== Before Special Edition, FAQ series and PC revisions (2026-11-12) ==

=== Missing data ===
* No copies found yet of: the First Anthology rules supplement sheet (only its cover, from Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2, on [[First Anthology]]), the Official Tournament Sealed Deck rules supplement (1998; Decipher's sealeddecksupp.htm has only 404 captures) or the first partial preliminary FAQ (5 June 1997). Their table cells are blank. The FAQ intro (1996), the 18 June 1997 FAQ and the 1998 Decipher rules index name these documents.
* Added later the same day: the Premiere starter deck rulebook (TIFF scans in a public Google Drive folder, owner not shown) and the Premiere Two-Player rules booklet (Hasbro's 2001 scan PDF). The Drive scans have no working PDF.
* Current Rulings of 29 March 1999 and 6 June 2000: Decipher URLs exist, but Wayback only captured 404s. Not listed.

=== Build notes ===
* The new working PDFs are byte-identical copies of the Wayback captures linked in the Archive PDF column (sha256 checked). For A New Hope and Hoth, Decipher's 1998 files (re-made July 1997) differ from the 1996 files, so both captures are linked and the 1998 file is hosted. The Players Committee copies of anewhoperules.pdf and hothrules.pdf match the 1998 files. The PC copy of cloudcityrules.pdf is an earlier 6 October 1997 build; the hosted Decipher file is dated 10 October 1997.
* Release months come from the set pages' infoboxes.
* Preserved copies (sha256-matched) added for the three current PC PDFs.
